# Building a FastAPI Application with Okteto - Part 1 - Getting Started


Welcome back to our video series - Building a FastAPI Application with Okteto. This is Part 1: Getting Started.


In this video, we'll be setting up our FastAPI application structure as well as creating the initial deployment to Okteto and setting up our dev environments.
